source.migration_policy: Keep .ores supported until a backend-specific versioned migration removes support.
extension_support_requires: positive native execution or target execution

compatibility_invariants: Do not rename existing GitHub organizations or repositories as part of the branding migration.
Do not rename package coordinates, Cargo crate names, NuGet package IDs, Java packages, Wasm module names, or linker symbols in a branding-only change.
Do not change binary serialization, diagnostic JSON, protocol versions, ABI layouts, guest wire formats, or persistent storage keys.
Preserve old compiler executable names and environment variables until independently versioned migration tooling exists.
OresForge, OresVM, oresforge, orescranelift, and other engine/backend identifiers remain distinct technical identities unless explicitly versioned.
Do not infer language feature parity from branding, README wording, filename forwarding, or parser admission alone.
